findings: Blocker (correctness/recovery, p001_runtime_setup.verify_transcript): add_code_cell payloads are exact-matched but run_code_cell exchanges are neither counted nor bound to cells — only runs[0..2] are inspected. A transcript with additional trailing run_code_cell calls (retried setup/environment cell, or execution of a pre-existing notebook cell) or repeated __open_colab_browser_connection calls still yields SOURCE_DEPENDENCIES_AND_DEFAULT_CHILD_ENVIRONMENT_VERIFIED, contradicting the once-only/no-retry/no-reconnect worker contract the receipt attests, and fewer than three runs raises a bare IndexError instead of a classified SETUP_ error. In-cell guards make a second execution fail harmlessly, so this is receipt honesty, not immediate data exposure, but the receipt feeds the later launch-decision chain. Unless the frozen verify_cell_sources (0770, not supplied) provably enforces exactly-once execution bound by cellId — not evidenced in this module or its tests — add the smallest fix locally: require len(runs)==3, at most one connection-open, bind each runs[i]['input']['cellId'] to the i-th add_code_cell result's newCellId, and add a test rejecting a transcript with a duplicated trailing run.

Suggestion (correctness, main): prepare mode with missing --snapshot/--runtime-packet/--runtime-receipt/--request-id, or verify mode with missing --packet/--protocol, fails with TypeError/AttributeError on None rather than parser.error (the intake verify mode has this guard). Fail-closed but unclassified; add the same argument-presence check.

Suggestion (robustness/privacy, verify_transcript and main): the setup-run stream has no size bound before splitlines()/ast.literal_eval (environment output is bounded at 132096), and ast.literal_eval on malformed lines can raise SyntaxError, which is not caught as a classified failure; bound the setup output and catch SyntaxError as SETUP_TRANSPORT_OUTPUT_SCHEMA. The --output receipt is opened 'x' then chmod 0600 without setting umask, leaving a brief default-permission window (bounded metadata only, low impact).

Suggestion (recovery hygiene, observe_environment): environment-intent.json and environment.console.log receive 0600 permissions only via the os.umask(0o077) that claim_setup set in the prior cell of the same kernel; the coupling is sound because the fingerprint re-check binds both cells to the same kernel PID, but setting the umask locally in observe_environment removes the implicit cross-cell dependency.

Verified sound: frozen-byte checks before reusing capture_cell and notebook cells 1/3; reviewed 7z lines re-verified as AST constants at the preparation pin; exclusive 'x'-mode intents with reconcile-not-retry semantics and pre-created append-only logs; symlink refusal on all staged paths; child probe rejects shadowed import origins before importing and emits only schema-bounded metadata with private console retention; setup root bound to the runtime fingerprint preventing a second request from claiming a fresh directory; patient_launch_authorized and scientific_acceptance held False end-to-end with no frozen approval altered.
